'''Sense danger''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to extend their senses to create a kind of early warning system to alert them to potential dangers, such as attacks directed at them.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[detect life]] spell.
